sources_considered.why: Primary independent evaluation reports released-model scores, incomplete high-reasoning coverage and differences from the December preview.
Read to check the original result; the April report itself provides the historical comparison and necessary qualifications.

receipt.public_excerpt: did not return enough task completions to support reliable scoring.

evidence_items.explanation: As reported April 22, o3-medium scored 53% on ARC-AGI-1's semi-private set, while o3-high returned only 37 of 100 tasks; the evaluator rejected its 82% returned-task accuracy as unrepresentative. The same report affirms the December result but explains that production o3 differed in model, training and available compute, supporting practical non-reproduction rather than invalidity of the original experiment.

unresolved_gaps: The report does not provide a completed repeat evaluation of the identical December preview configuration.
